# ADR 0005: Staging + transform loading with COPY

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** AML transaction monitoring

## Context

Millions of rows must load quickly and repeatably.

## Decision

COPY raw files into a staging table, then transform into the model with SQL in one transaction.

## Consequences

Fastest load path; easy reprocessing.

## Alternatives considered

Row-by-row inserts.
